error_found: Bad archive returns 500 instead of 400: POST /api/v1/batch with a non-ZIP payload named .zip (STL bytes, application/zip) -> HTTP 500 'Internal Server Error' (reproduced twice). Cause: batch_service.extract_zip_path_to_items opens zipfile.ZipFile which raises zipfile.BadZipFile; batch_router.py only catches ValueError around extraction, so BadZipFile escapes as an unhandled 500. Expected 400 per story.
